newsitem.title: USA: Sparks said to peg 1997 corn 9.47 bln, soy 2.686.
newsitem.headline: Sparks said to peg 1997 corn 9.47 bln, soy 2.686.

text.p: Memphis-based analytical firm Sparks Companies was said to have pegged 1997 U.S. corn production at 9.47 billion bushels and soybean production at 2.686 billion bushels, trade sources said.
USDA in July projected 1997 U.S. corn production at 9.7 billion and soybean production at 2.69 billion bushels.
Also, sources said that Sparks pegged 1997 U.S. total wheat production at 2.531 billion bushels, above USDA's July forecast for 2.431 billion.
Sparks Companies officials could not be reached for comment on the estimates.
